compounds.working_name: Veto reserve reproduction trap

component_ideas.proposition: If a resident may veto a care robot task only after arranging substitute labor, then formal veto availability can fall as other residents stop maintaining substitute routines.

If separately approved commitments reserve the same refusal-compatible substitutes, then their combination can cross a threshold at which no jointly feasible refusal path remains, even while every grant stays fixed and review utilization stays low; veto effectiveness should track residual substitute feasibility rather than approval count.

If institutions fund dispute staff from recent complaint volume, improved agent reliability can reduce independent review capacity enough that rare future failures receive worse remedies than under a less reliable system with a maintained dispute workforce.

compounds.strongest_version: Valid commitments consume common substitutes while reliable routine service reduces complaint-funded review practice. If exercising a veto requires both a substitute and competent interpretation, falling use of vetoes can make those two resources look unnecessary and justify further reductions.

signed_edges.mechanism: Each commitment reserves the same fallback labor.
Less unreserved capacity remains.
Reviewers can identify and execute legitimate refusal paths.
Available routes can actually be exercised.
A use-based budget supports the resources.
Funding sustains interpretive practice.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Low feasible vetoes lower observed use, which lowers resource funding and makes later vetoes still less feasible; commitment-driven reserve consumption initiates the loop.

compounds.emergent_property: Self-maintaining nominal veto rights with neither jointly available labor nor independent interpretive capacity.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: The components separately describe labor-conditioned veto, shared reservation feasibility and reliability-linked review budgets; none links low exercised veto demand back to reproduction of both enabling resources.
compounds.surprising_prediction: At equal permissions and comprehension at deployment, lowering routine failures can accelerate later veto infeasibility when funding responds to observed veto use.

measurable_state_variable.name: joint veto reserve
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Number of simultaneous legitimate vetoes executable with both spare labor and competent independent reviewers.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A bottleneck regime begins when either spare substitute capacity or reviewer capacity falls below joint veto demand; use-linked replenishment permits persistence after demand falls.
assumptions: Funding responds to exercised rather than latent demand.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: With those rules fixed, declining exercised vetoes does not reduce enabling resources or future feasible vetoes.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same use-responsive funding loop can build robust refusal capacity where exercised legitimate vetoes reveal latent need and induce investment rather than decay.
compounds.neutral_control: Both resources are funded independently of current veto use.

survival_rules_met.support: Joint veto reserve separates nominal rights from joint execution.
Two complementary capacity bottlenecks bound feasible vetoes.
Fund latent capacity rather than merely add approval prompts.

compounds.uncertainty: Funding responsiveness and which resource binds are unmeasured; low veto use can also reflect genuine satisfaction, not control loss.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Hold protected fallback and reviewer funding fixed while routine veto use falls.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Reliability improvements no longer reduce later veto feasibility through the claimed funding channel; independent reserve overbooking may remain.

compounds.working_name: Correction creates an evidence arrears queue

component_ideas.proposition: If a person can correct a profile at its origin but downstream institutions retain decisions derived from the earlier profile, then the correction right fails to restore opportunities unless derivations are revisited.
If public agents initially reject circumstances outside an executable category scheme, then broadening that scheme later cannot repair claims whose evidence or filing opportunity has expired.

If challenge rights require reading complete ancestry records before filing and the records grow with automation volume, formally increased transparency can reduce the fraction of low-resource challengers who reach a substantive hearing before a deadline.

compounds.strongest_version: An accepted origin correction triggers reopening across downstream decisions, but each reopened case demands a longer complete ancestry before admission. New corrections can expand the required reconstruction backlog faster than claimants can enter it, causing expiry of precisely the claims correction was meant to repair.

signed_edges.mechanism: One corrected profile supports several prior decisions.
Each decision requires its derivation chain.
Claimants have finite reading capacity.
Admission enables bounded repair.
Later decisions build on still-unresolved derivations.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Unrepaired derivations continue to generate later ancestry, raising reconstruction burdens and delaying admission of their corrections.

compounds.emergent_property: Successful correction at the origin generates a growing arrears stock rather than effective network correction.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Reopening duties, irreversible filing loss and ancestry admission burdens are individually stated; their recursive effect on the ancestry of later decisions is not.
compounds.surprising_prediction: A more responsive origin-correction service can increase unresolved downstream disputes if reopening fans out while admission remains ancestry-gated.

measurable_state_variable.name: correction arrears
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Consequential derived decisions awaiting repair, weighted by the reconstruction work needed before their claims can be admitted.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Arrears grow when correction-induced reopening work plus new derived work exceeds admissible reconstruction throughput; restoring throughput later does not restore expired opportunities.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Reopening fan-out does not increase pending reconstruction or expired claims under the specified admission rule.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same derivation-triggered reopening loop propagates useful corrections quickly when concise admission and sufficient reconstruction capacity keep repairs ahead of new derivations.
compounds.neutral_control: Corrected profiles have no consequential downstream derivations.

survival_rules_met.support: Work-weighted correction arrears is observable.
Reopening work can cross reconstruction capacity.
Origin correction success and network repair cease to be equivalent.

compounds.uncertainty: The assumed reopening rule and recursion may not hold in real institutions; no prevalence or bad-faith conclusion follows.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Bound reopened claims to their corrected source and exclude unresolved descendants from subsequent admission prerequisites.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Faster origin correction cannot amplify future ancestry work through unresolved descendants; the initial reopening burst remains.

compounds.working_name: Privacy victory through collateral substitution

component_ideas.proposition: If recipients can delete intimate care logs but those logs are the only evidence for contesting a harmful staffing decision, then privacy exercise and procedural redress can become mutually obstructive.

If a regulator must reconstruct an agent incident after local logs were minimized and cannot target a narrow evidence path, stronger routine minimization can increase total privacy exposure by forcing broad requests for third-party communications.

If proof that an agent may negotiate requires displaying earlier relationship transactions, a current principal can gain counterpart recognition by revealing identities and terms of previous counterparties who never consented to this new evidentiary use.

compounds.strongest_version: Deleting a principal's intimate care evidence can force both appeals and new authority proofs to seek prior counterpart records. If each collateral request then creates its own evidentiary basis for future proofs, deletion can move a growing documentary burden into the non-user network rather than remove it.

signed_edges.mechanism: The appeal loses its original record.
Investigators and mandate recognizers seek substitutes.
Responses become retained evidence.
Institutions reuse convenient recognized records.
Later gaps require confirmation of these records.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Collateral records become the recognized substitute history and create future confirmation demand on the same absent parties.

compounds.emergent_property: A privacy-minimized account coupled to an expanding external proof bureaucracy.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Deletion/redress conflict, wider investigation and prior-counterparty proof exposure do not individually specify the substitution records becoming the next generation of mandate evidence.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Repeated account minimization can increase non-user documentary workload even while the account's retained bytes decline monotonically.

measurable_state_variable.name: external evidence dependence
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Share of appeal and mandate validity supported by non-user records and repeated confirmations.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Substitution grows where collateral proof reuse outpaces expiry; it saturates or reverses when independently sufficient minimal receipts break further requests.
assumptions: Collateral responses are retained and reused.
Deletion does not cancel the underlying dispute or mandate.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Collateral responses neither persist into later proofs nor generate additional confirmation demand.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same evidence-substitution network can restore a silenced person's claims where willing counterparties hold accurate corroboration and reuse reduces repeated storytelling.
compounds.neutral_control: Deletion leaves a sufficient nonidentifying dispute and mandate receipt.

survival_rules_met.support: External evidence dependence differs from account retention.
Preserve sufficient receipts rather than maximize or minimize raw logs indiscriminately.
Local privacy improvement can coexist with greater network disclosure.

compounds.uncertainty: Reuse may be prohibited; collateral exposure can be benign or wanted. Total welfare requires affected-party assessment.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Make collateral evidence single-use and prohibit treating it as the default history for later mandate recognition.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Principal deletion can still trigger one investigation, but repeated confirmation duties do not propagate onto the same non-users.

compounds.working_name: Rehearsal-priced renewal lock

component_ideas.proposition: If a service institution observes users rehearsing substitute arrangements, then it may offer better terms before exit while users who cannot rehearse appear less contestable despite equal service satisfaction.

If a provider controls fallback drills and supplies recoverable cases drawn from its own decision traces, it can report strong human takeover performance while failing to train distinctions needed when the provider and its traces disappear together.

If a program pays professionals for fallback drill completion but does not measure which judgments were exercised, the cheapest bids can come from professionals using agents to complete the drills, increasing certified reserve counts without producing more independent capacity.

compounds.strongest_version: Visible exit rehearsal wins better renewal terms, while completion subsidies favor provider-trace-dependent drills. Users can therefore gain bargaining rewards from rehearsals that do not build independent recovery; improved renewal terms may reduce actual exits, leaving the hidden training dependency untested.

signed_edges.mechanism: Providers treat completed drills as contestability evidence.
Incumbent responds with better terms.
Users remain for attractive terms.
Real transfers expose trace dependence.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Cheap completions induce concessions, fewer actual exits and less independent validation, preserving the cheap curriculum.

compounds.emergent_property: High apparent contestability and good renewal prices with low tested recovery autonomy.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Bargaining effects of rehearsal, trace dependency and subsidy selection do not individually describe concessions suppressing the transfers that would test the rehearsal signal.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Better retention offers can improve user prices while slowing discovery that exit certificates depend on incumbent traces.

measurable_state_variable.name: unvalidated contestability
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Completed exit certificates not independently validated through trace-free novel transfer.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A stable apparent-contestability regime is possible if concession-induced retention suppresses validation faster than independent drills invalidate certificates.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Concessions do not reduce independent validation or trace-based drills predict genuine trace-free exit equally well.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same rehearsal-concession-validation loop can sustain useful competition without repeated disruptive switching when rehearsals genuinely certify independent substitutes.
compounds.neutral_control: Rehearsal validation is independent of actual exit frequency.

survival_rules_met.support: Unvalidated contestability distinguishes prices from autonomy.

compounds.uncertainty: The behavioral retention response is assumed; concessions need not be manipulative and can be valuable.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Provide the same concession but randomly require independently supported transfer trials regardless of renewal.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Better renewal prices no longer suppress the observations that reveal incumbent-scaffolded certificates.

compounds.working_name: The stop-settlement wave

component_ideas.proposition: If posthumous agents create pending exchanges under a valid mandate, then revoking that mandate stops new action but can leave living counterparties bound to reservations or expectations created earlier.

If an agent can stop issuing commitments immediately but its existing commitments mature over long and uneven intervals, evaluating revocation only by new-action cessation will understate residual exposure; two agents with identical stopping latency can produce different recovery cash and coordination needs because their obligation maturity distributions differ.

If providers sell recovery guarantees against the same small pool of substitute infrastructure without disclosing overlap, the market price of insured recovery can fall while the quantity of simultaneously deliverable restoration remains fixed.

compounds.strongest_version: Simultaneous legitimate revocation stops new agent commitments quickly but releases many matured or pending obligations into the same restoration pool. Fast coordinated stopping can create a settlement demand wave whose delays leave counterparties treating old representation as practically active.

compounds.neutral_control: No pending obligations or counterparty reservations remain at revocation.

component_ideas.proposition: If an organization continues accepting a deceased member agent as the most informed representative of that member interests, then living successors may bear proof burdens to exercise rights already transferred to them.

If different institutions recognize an inherited agent as continuous for different purposes, then successors may claim continuity where it preserves assets and discontinuity where it avoids burdens.

compounds.neutral_control: Authority transfer automatically transfers recognized representation to an accountable successor body.

survival_rules_met.support: Successor voice deficit is distinct from ownership.

compounds.working_name: Review windows consume each other's validity

component_ideas.proposition: If each institution provides a sufficient local review period but its disclosed conditions expire asynchronously, then a shared action can lack any interval in which all conditions are simultaneously valid and reviewable; extending the final deadline alone will not restore effective joint review.

If institutions promise agent-supported projects guaranteed future human review without accounting for overlapping review commitments, selling more projects can create claims on the same attention slots and turn overdue review into pressure to approve bundled outcomes.

If personal agents faithfully reactivate old commitments from several life roles, then individually valid reminders can jointly demand more attention than the person can supply without any single request being excessive.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Preserve reversible machine suspension while independently maintaining ordinary witness-producing human encounters.

compounds.working_name: Certifier migration turns competition into a cut

component_ideas.proposition: If institutions accept agent transfers only after a recognized migration certificate, then tested portability can improve trust while certificate issuance becomes a new gate on access to substitutes.

If new agent providers introduce mutually incompatible obligation attestations and counterparties cannot afford all adapters, provider entry can reduce the fraction of relationships preserved after switching even as the number of nominal substitutes grows.

If a user’s counterparties accept credentials through a small set of mutually recognizing issuers, removing one issuer can disconnect most replacement-agent routes even when every profile is exportable and several replacement providers exist; replacement success should track recognition-path connectivity rather than provider count.

compounds.strongest_version: Provider entry creates more attestation formats while migration certification becomes the trusted acceptance gate. With fixed counterparty adapter budgets, institutions may centralize compatibility through one certifier, turning many competing providers into a market dependent on a single recognition cut.

signed_edges.mechanism: More formats need interpretation.
A common certificate reduces local work.
Counterparties stop funding alternative proofs.
Alternatives permit replacement without that certifier.
Transactions increasingly require its stamp.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Adapter scarcity encourages a common gate whose growing use weakens alternatives and deepens dependence on the gate.

compounds.emergent_property: Competitive provider supply with concentrated practical recognition power.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Certificate institutions, fragmentation and recognition cuts do not individually specify provider competition financing the emergence of a single certifier cut.
compounds.surprising_prediction: At fixed adapter capacity, more provider entry can increase certifier concentration even as provider concentration falls.

measurable_state_variable.name: recognition concentration gap
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Difference between provider diversity and the diversity of independently accepted migration proofs.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A gate regime can form when direct adaptation costs exceed common-certification costs and proof alternatives decay through nonuse.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Provider-format entry leaves alternative recognition paths and certifier dependence unchanged.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same central certification feedback can make previously incompatible providers usable and expand choice when alternative accountable proof paths remain available.
compounds.neutral_control: Direct recognition is cheap and alternatives are maintained independently of current use.

survival_rules_met.support: Recognition concentration gap is observable.
Support proof-path plurality rather than count providers only.
The certifier gains practical gate power without wider provider microgrants.

compounds.uncertainty: Certification can be legitimate and useful; actual budget substitution and proof-route decay are unmeasured.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Central certifier reliance → independent recognition paths
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Fund diverse independent attestation adapters at fixed coverage even when central certification is widely used.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Additional provider formats may raise interpretation work but need not increase indispensability of one certifier as alternatives decay.

compounds.working_name: Contestability purchases its own measurement

component_ideas.proposition: If a service institution observes users rehearsing substitute arrangements, then it may offer better terms before exit while users who cannot rehearse appear less contestable despite equal service satisfaction.

If providers can sell improved interventions using privately estimated response curves but users cannot buy comparable estimates of their own exposure sensitivity, market competition can improve targeting faster than it improves users’ ability to compare the resulting relationships.

If users respond to truthful uncertainty disclosure by allocating more trials to the most legible provider, improved transparency can reduce population-wide evidence about less legible competitors despite increasing each disclosed estimate’s accuracy.

compounds.strongest_version: Providers respond to visible exit preparation while users direct trial budgets toward services with legible uncertainty. If incumbent response estimates make its trials easier to interpret, rehearsal-induced concessions can keep the user in the best-measured service and starve comparisons with less legible substitutes.

signed_edges.mechanism: The service can explain measured response variation.
Users spend limited trials where they understand outcomes.
More observations improve its estimates.
Incumbent responds to contestability.
Fewer substantive substitute trials occur.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Legibility attracts data that improves legibility; retention concessions weaken the alternative validation that could interrupt this concentration.

compounds.emergent_property: Improving transparency and bargaining terms alongside deteriorating evidence about actual substitutes.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Rehearsal bargaining, private causal measurement and disclosure-directed auditions do not separately describe concessions coupling the two learning loops.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Users with stronger visible exit preparation can receive better prices yet know less about substitute response profiles after repeated renewals.

measurable_state_variable.name: outside-option evidence coverage
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Independently identified response regimes among feasible substitutes, not nominal offers.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Evidence concentration persists if legibility advantages and retention response divert a fixed trial budget faster than information transfers between providers.
assumptions: Incumbent knowledge is not fully portable.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Concessions and legibility do not reduce independent substitute-response coverage.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same legibility-learning feedback can identify a genuinely superior coach quickly and retain a valuable relationship without costly repeated switching.
compounds.neutral_control: A fixed independent audition budget samples substitutes irrespective of retention offers.

survival_rules_met.support: Outside-option evidence coverage distinguishes offers from knowledge.
Protect independent auditions rather than suppress useful disclosure.
Better renewal terms need not imply a better-understood outside option.

compounds.uncertainty: Users may rationally prefer concentration; measurement loss is not automatically welfare loss.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Assign equal substantive substitute trials after concession and non-concession renewals.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Stronger bargaining can improve price without reducing comparative substitute evidence, although incumbent legibility can still attract voluntary trials.

compounds.working_name: Recognition proofs accumulate relational collateral

component_ideas.proposition: If proof that an agent may negotiate requires displaying earlier relationship transactions, a current principal can gain counterpart recognition by revealing identities and terms of previous counterparties who never consented to this new evidentiary use.

If a personal agent monetizes a portable interpretation of a relationship jointly produced by two people, the user can authorize its sale while the other person bears correction and reputational costs, because the product’s property model names only the account holder.

If a user’s commercial recognition depends on a provider’s continuing liability guarantee, profile portability alone cannot create a substitute market unless another guarantor can assess and price the obligations it would inherit.

compounds.strongest_version: Successor guarantors price an agent's obligations using portable relationship interpretations and prior transactions. Each new guarantee can increase counterpart recognition while drawing more people into the evidentiary collateral needed for later underwriting, even if all account holders consent to their own records.

signed_edges.mechanism: Guarantors assess continuing obligations.
Shared records inform risk.
Recognition enables further commitments.
More jointly produced history accumulates.
Richer assessable history supports guarantees.
Assessable evidence allows more guarantees to be issued.
Issued successor guarantees become the counterparty's recognition basis.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Guarantees enable transactions that create more relational collateral, increasing the scope of later proof dependence and exposure.

compounds.emergent_property: A portable trust system whose collateral is partly other people's interpreted relationships.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Proof exposure, interpretation ownership and successor underwriting do not individually specify recognized guarantees expanding jointly consequential evidentiary collateral.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Improving guarantee portability can increase the number of absent people whose reputations affect or are affected by successor recognition.

measurable_state_variable.name: relational collateral radius
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Distinct non-contracting parties whose records or interpretations materially support a user's recognized guarantees.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Radius expands when underwriting reuses relational evidence across transactions faster than proofs can be narrowed or expired.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Underwriting portability does not expand affected-party evidence use at matched transaction growth.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same relational collateral loop can make legitimate small participants trustworthy where accurate jointly beneficial history substitutes for unaffordable financial collateral.
compounds.neutral_control: Guarantees use independently sufficient nonrelational attestations.

survival_rules_met.support: Relational collateral radius makes absent parties countable.
Bound proof dependence and preserve affected-party correction.
Recognition reach expands without a new permission from each affected nonparty.

compounds.uncertainty: No current financial or legal claim is asserted; relational evidence could be unnecessary or voluntarily beneficial.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Recognized guarantees → new transactions → joint relationship evidence
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Allow guarantee portability but isolate evidence used for each guarantee from subsequently produced relational records.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Guarantees may enable trade but do not expand later recognition's absent-party evidentiary radius through accumulated transactions.

compounds.working_name: The adapter quorum boundary

component_ideas.proposition: If each institution provides a sufficient local review period but its disclosed conditions expire asynchronously, then a shared action can lack any interval in which all conditions are simultaneously valid and reviewable; extending the final deadline alone will not restore effective joint review.

If each institution exports a usable local schedule but their representations omit dependencies on one another, then successful separate migrations can destroy the feasibility of a joint care-work plan.

If each institution pays for adapters only to its frequent counterparties, uncommon but legitimate mandate combinations can remain untranslatable even when a connected public compatibility layer would cost less in total, because no pair captures its network benefit.

compounds.strongest_version: A multi-institution action requires both dependency-preserving translation and overlapping validity windows. Pairwise adapter funding can cover common bilateral traffic while leaving no jointly valid connected path for an uncommon legitimate workflow, producing a sharp failure that no local migration test detects.

signed_edges.mechanism: Enough compatible edges connect all required roles.
Cross-record constraints remain available.
All terms can be reviewed together.

causal_loop.explicit_threshold: Joint feasibility requires the intersection of three sets: translated dependency paths, compatible commitments and shared validity intervals. Crossing any one from nonempty to empty discontinuously removes the workflow.

compounds.emergent_property: Locally usable exports and adequate bilateral adapters with zero complete legitimate workflow.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Window overlap, cross-export dependencies and compatibility as a network good do not individually specify the three-way feasibility intersection.
compounds.surprising_prediction: An extra adapter can add many successful bilateral transfers while leaving joint feasibility exactly zero if condition validity remains nonoverlapping.

measurable_state_variable.name: joint compatibility volume
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Number or duration of complete dependency-preserving, jointly valid workflow paths.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A quorum threshold occurs when every required role has at least one common valid translation path; this is a conditional set-intersection model, not a new theorem.
assumptions: Partial execution is not an acceptable substitute.
Dependency and validity tests are accurate.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: The complete workflow executes legitimately despite an empty claimed intersection, or enlarging that intersection adds no feasible workflow.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same conjunctive compatibility structure ensures that one funded missing path unlocks an entire useful care-work plan while preserving distributed institutional control.
compounds.neutral_control: The workflow is truly bilateral with no cross-role dependency or asynchronous conditions.

survival_rules_met.support: Joint compatibility volume measures the complete object.
Set intersection creates an explicit all-required-role threshold.
Pairwise transfer success differs from complete workflow feasibility.

compounds.uncertainty: Required-role definitions and acceptable partial service are normative choices; no universal incompatibility theorem is claimed.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Validity-window overlap in the three-set intersection
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Keep adapter coverage and dependency constraints unchanged but provide a jointly valid review interval.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Bilateral improvements can now enable the previously blocked workflow; persistent zero feasibility cannot be attributed to the missing time intersection.

compounds.working_name: Procurement makes informal expertise unaskable

component_ideas.proposition: If organizations with heavy apprenticeship investment lose short-run contracts to high-output automated firms, then training capacity can contract through organizational replacement before any firm explicitly reduces its own training.

If purchasing agents recognize only digitally certified professional advice, competent rural or informal practitioners can lose clients even when their actual judgments are superior, because they cannot afford the attestation infrastructure used to admit advice.
If an institution preserves appeals but automates the junior work that trained appeal reviewers, then the rights can remain stable while their exercise becomes slower or more template-dependent.

compounds.strongest_version: Short-run procurement replaces training-heavy organizations while automated counterparties recognize only formal digital expertise. Informal experts who could repair unusual appeals become harder to recruit, reducing the apparent supply of independent expertise and strengthening procurement's preference for automated firms.

signed_edges.mechanism: Training costs reduce current bids.
These institutions reproduce review competence.
Alternative demonstrations are not accepted.
Available interpreters handle uncommon cases.
Effective review makes human alternatives credible.
Buyers favor the measured high-output route.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Weak expert recognition and reproduction worsen review, making automation appear relatively superior and reinforcing its procurement advantage.

compounds.emergent_property: A shrinking credible human-review sector despite surviving unrecognized practical competence.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Organization selection, format exclusion and appeal-pipeline loss do not individually specify apparent comparative advantage feeding back into procurement.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Credential subsidies alone may not restore independent appeals if the organizations that train and employ recognized experts have already disappeared.

measurable_state_variable.name: credible expertise supply
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Practitioners who both possess transfer competence and are institutionally recruitable for independent review.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Decline persists when organizational exit exceeds expert reproduction and recognition barriers prevent substituting informal experts.
assumptions: Informal competence can exist outside accepted attestations.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Procurement, recognition and reviewer supply vary without the predicted feedback in appeal quality or selection.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same credibility-procurement loop can reward genuinely transferable training and spread independent expertise when buyers count expert reproduction and accept equivalent demonstrations.
compounds.neutral_control: Expert supply and recognition are publicly maintained outside vendor procurement.

survival_rules_met.support: Credible expertise supply separates skill from recruitability.
Combine production support with recognition repair.
Surviving skilled people differ from an operational reviewer sector.

compounds.uncertainty: Perceived automation advantage may reflect real superiority; this model does not assume every incumbent trainer should survive.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Apparent automation advantage → short-run output procurement
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Protect expertise-training organizations from procurement metrics while leaving digital admission requirements unchanged.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Loss of appeal credibility cannot finance further disappearance of the training supply; format exclusion can remain independently harmful or beneficial.

compounds.working_name: Shared repair changes the independence budget

component_ideas.proposition: If agents using a common model publish verified counterexamples in a format that transfers across institutions, shared-model exposure can accelerate correction enough to reduce cumulative loss relative to diverse isolated models when failures are detectable and repair latency dominates damage.
If an assistant supplies the categories used by later independent reviewers, agreement across reviewers can reflect shared framing rather than robustness of the underlying evidence.

If individually independent permission reviewers all use context produced by the same agent infrastructure, increasing reviewer count need not diversify the evidence governing population-wide renewal.

compounds.strongest_version: A common stack rapidly propagates verified repairs, but repeated efficient repair can induce institutions to reduce independently framed evaluation. The same shared repair channel may then become the sole source of the categories that decide what counts as a failure.

signed_edges.mechanism: Verified fixes reach many institutions.
Budgets respond to visible problems.
Review supports independent categories.
Different frames detect omitted distinctions.
Unrecognized failures are absent from reports.
Institutions rely on the efficient channel.
Reliance funds and uses the common update channel.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Successful shared repair can suppress the independent frames needed to detect what its own evidence channel misses.

compounds.emergent_property: Low reported failures and rapid verified repair with reduced capacity to recognize a novel failure class.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Repair externalities and common review frames do not individually specify repair success reallocating the independence budget.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Faster common repair can worsen detection of frame-changing failures even while reducing known-case loss.

measurable_state_variable.name: independent failure vocabulary reserve
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Failure distinctions institutions can generate and validate without the common repair channel.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A frame lock appears when independent frame production falls below replacement needs and apparent completeness governs reinvestment.
assumptions: Evaluation budgets respond to observed failures.
Some failure classes require different frames.
Shared repairs do not preserve all independent skills automatically.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Repair speed does not reduce independent framing or independent frames add no detection on novel classes.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same shared dissemination loop can preserve a hard-won failure vocabulary across many institutions when repairs transmit independently verifiable distinctions rather than only verdicts.
compounds.neutral_control: Independent frame production is funded regardless of common repair performance.

survival_rules_met.support: Failure vocabulary reserve is distinct from patch speed.
Budget independent framing alongside repair dissemination.
Low known-case loss differs from novel-class detectability.

compounds.uncertainty: Frame-changing failures and budget substitution are hypothetical; common repair is not intrinsically fragile.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Common repair success → independent frame budget
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Maintain independently trained failure-vocabulary teams at fixed budget after successful common repairs.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Improved common repair no longer predicts weaker detection of novel failure classes through budget displacement.

compounds.working_name: Correction becomes an underwriting event

component_ideas.proposition: If each successor agent accepts signed imported profiles but recognizes only its own users as authorized to challenge an inference, repeated transfers can leave an affected person with no competent correction forum although every local profile has an identifiable issuer.

If a user’s commercial recognition depends on a provider’s continuing liability guarantee, profile portability alone cannot create a substitute market unless another guarantor can assess and price the obligations it would inherit.

If a user exports a relationship profile that includes contested interpretations of a contact, replacement agents can repeatedly act on those interpretations even after the contact corrects the original service, unless the correction itself propagates with the relationship record.

compounds.strongest_version: A transferred relationship inference can support a successor guarantee while the affected non-user has no reachable correction forum. If guarantees make the inference harder to reopen because many counterparties rely on it, each accepted transfer can convert a corrigible account into liability-backed institutional history.

signed_edges.mechanism: Recognized obligations use the transferred account.
Correction affects multiple accepted guarantees.
Forums or claimants cannot bear the work.
Accepted corrections revise reuse.
The unrevised account remains the available basis.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Recognition-induced reliance increases correction cost, sustaining the evidence that supports further recognition.

compounds.emergent_property: An inference acquiring practical finality through legitimate guarantees without gaining epistemic certainty.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Forum migration, successor guarantees and correction propagation do not individually specify reliance liabilities increasing the cost of correction.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Guarantee portability can make profile correction less usable even with unchanged export accuracy and cryptographic provenance.

measurable_state_variable.name: liability-weighted correction radius
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Obligations requiring reconsideration when one relational inference is corrected.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Practical finality arises when reconsideration work exceeds accessible correction capacity and no institution has a duty to fund the radius.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Added guaranteed reliance does not increase correction burden or diminish reachable remedy.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same liability-backed history protects counterparties from arbitrary revision where the inference is sound and coordinated correction is funded.
compounds.neutral_control: Guarantees use independently verified facts unaffected by the contested interpretation.

survival_rules_met.support: Liability-weighted correction radius measures dependence.
Fund coordinated reconsideration rather than only origin edits.
Provenance certainty differs from affordable correction.

compounds.uncertainty: The link from interpretive correction to actual obligations must be specified; no claim of deliberate lock-in follows.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Keep guarantees and reuse fixed but pre-fund bounded correction of all guarantee-linked descendants.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Wider guarantee reuse need not reduce affordable correction through accumulating reopening liabilities.

compounds.working_name: Honest uncertainty concentrates the experiment commons

component_ideas.proposition: If a contract treats disclosed model uncertainty as risk accepted by the customer, better-calibrated uncertainty reports can shift more loss to customers without changing the action policy or giving them a usable opportunity to choose a substitute.

If providers can sell improved interventions using privately estimated response curves but users cannot buy comparable estimates of their own exposure sensitivity, market competition can improve targeting faster than it improves users’ ability to compare the resulting relationships.

If users respond to truthful uncertainty disclosure by allocating more trials to the most legible provider, improved transparency can reduce population-wide evidence about less legible competitors despite increasing each disclosed estimate’s accuracy.

compounds.strongest_version: Truthful uncertainty disclosure can shift risk to users while directing their limited trial budget toward the most legible provider. If that provider privately learns from those trials, the parties bearing experimental risk may become least able to compare alternatives, increasing later acceptance of the same risk-allocation terms.

signed_edges.mechanism: Users can understand these trials.
Provider learns from trial outcomes.
Better calibrated explanations become available.
Users can identify another suitable service.
Feasible alternatives improve choice.
More experimentation cost stays with users.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: A legibility-learning loop concentrates knowledge while user-funded exposure and weak alternatives sustain the same terms.

compounds.emergent_property: Increasingly accurate disclosure paired with concentrated causal knowledge and asymmetric experimentation costs.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Contractual risk acknowledgment, private response curves and trial allocation do not individually specify who finances the evidence concentration loop.
compounds.surprising_prediction: More accurate uncertainty disclosure can reduce users' comparative knowledge per unit of risk borne if trials concentrate and measurements remain private.

measurable_state_variable.name: experimental reciprocity ratio
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Usable self-relevant comparative knowledge returned to users per unit of user-borne experimentation risk.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Low-reciprocity concentration persists if trial data stay private and legibility determines repeated allocation under finite budgets.
assumptions: Private estimates do not fully transfer.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Disclosure concentration does not reduce knowledge returned per risk borne under the stated privacy and budget rules.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same user-funded calibrated-trial structure can make effective coaching affordable when users knowingly value the experiment and receive useful comparative learning.
compounds.neutral_control: Measurement access is symmetric and trial risks are independently funded.

survival_rules_met.support: Experimental reciprocity ratio separates transparency from return.
Change measurement access or cost allocation rather than suppress uncertainty.
Accurate disclosure and reciprocal learning are different observables.

compounds.uncertainty: Risk and knowledge require context-sensitive units; favorable coaching may justify the arrangement without making it coercive.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Hold response disclosures fixed but allocate trials to each provider independently of demonstrated legibility.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Truthful incumbent uncertainty no longer concentrates unpaid experiments through this attraction channel; comparative ignorance from other sources may remain.

compounds.working_name: Fast closure hardens the slow-channel norm

component_ideas.proposition: If a negotiating agent can recognize a binding refusal and settle all compatible offers at once, increasing its response speed can reduce persuasion exposure relative to a slow human process in which unresolved offers remain repeatedly actionable.
If an auctioneer benefits from agent participation, then it can shorten bid windows until buyers must adopt agents even when faster bidding adds no information useful to allocation.
If short institutional deadlines cause defensive adoption, then later lengthening deadlines may not reduce adoption because counterparties now expect machine-readable negotiation and coordination.

compounds.strongest_version: Fast agents with binding refusal can protect their users from prolonged bargaining, while institutions shorten windows to recruit those agents. As machine-readable closure becomes expected, later deadline expansion can fail to restore non-user participation because acceptance now depends on the installed protocol.

signed_edges.mechanism: Recognized refusals settle proposals quickly.
Fast completion becomes the valued norm.
Humans need representation to keep up.
Counterparties standardize around agents.
Longer windows alone do not supply accepted formats.
Losing accepted human routes makes represented participation more attractive.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Adoption supports protocol expectations that preserve the advantage of the fast closure technology after timing rules change.

compounds.emergent_property: A beneficial anti-persuasion feature for users becomes a persistent representation prerequisite for non-users.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Fast closure, recruited speed and post-deadline protocol persistence do not individually trace protective bargaining capability into infrastructure normalization.
compounds.surprising_prediction: A policy that lengthens deadlines can restore thinking time without restoring participation if protocol acceptance remains machine-only.

measurable_state_variable.name: slow-channel recognition stock
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Institutions accepting complete unaided negotiation, including binding refusal, independent of speed.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Norm persistence arises if protocol switching costs exceed the gain from serving remaining non-users after deadlines expand.
assumptions: Formats remain sticky after rule revision.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Deadline expansion restores participation fully without changing acceptance protocols.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same closure-and-protocol feedback can make binding human refusals widely recognizable where public intermediaries keep the slow channel usable.
compounds.neutral_control: Timing improvements do not change accepted message formats.

survival_rules_met.support: Slow-channel recognition stock is measurable.
Change timing and acceptance norms together.
Participation rules change without additional non-user microgrants.

compounds.uncertainty: Institutional incentives and protocol stickiness are assumptions; fast closure itself can be strongly beneficial.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Require a parallel, equally effective slow-channel recognition path as machine-tempo practice spreads.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: More defensive agent use cannot lower unaided participation by making rapid form the exclusive recognized route.

compounds.working_name: Recovery guarantees train the wrong reserve

component_ideas.proposition: If providers sell recovery guarantees against the same small pool of substitute infrastructure without disclosing overlap, the market price of insured recovery can fall while the quantity of simultaneously deliverable restoration remains fixed.

If a program pays professionals for fallback drill completion but does not measure which judgments were exercised, the cheapest bids can come from professionals using agents to complete the drills, increasing certified reserve counts without producing more independent capacity.

If departing users rely on a small independent provider to reconstruct opaque histories but reconstruction expertise is learned only through unpaid low-margin transfers, portable exit rights can increase demand for a substitute whose training costs no contracting party funds.

compounds.strongest_version: Multiple providers sell restoration promises against the same substitute pool, while completion-paid training favors easy trace-supported drills. The pool can appear large in claims and certificates while receiving too little independent novice learning to expand deliverable recovery capacity.

signed_edges.mechanism: Promises require visible readiness evidence.
Cheap drills produce more completions.
Buyers count certificates as deliverable substitutes.
More promises can be marketed.
Transferable learning grows actual supply.
Readiness buyers finance the completion-measured training program.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Promise and certificate growth reinforce one another without necessarily financing the independent training stock needed to redeem simultaneous claims.

compounds.emergent_property: An expanding recovery-liability market with a static or shrinking genuinely independent substitute pool.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Shared claims, subsidy selection and orphaned substitute trainees do not individually specify claims demand shaping a misleading reserve-production market.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Higher training completion subsidies can lower the ratio of deliverable restoration to promised coverage if they divert effort toward scaffolded certifications.

measurable_state_variable.name: recovery coverage leverage
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Simultaneous promised restoration work divided by independently deliverable restoration capacity.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A leverage threshold is crossed when joint promised work exceeds deliverable capacity over the required horizon; certificates need not reveal the crossing.
assumptions: Training subsidies do not automatically fund novices' missing distinctions.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Certificate growth tracks deliverable independent capacity under common loss and simultaneous claims.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same promise-funded training feedback can expand genuine substitute supply when payment requires independent transfer performance and demand supports sustained training.
compounds.neutral_control: Each guarantee has independently verified exclusive or complementary capacity.

survival_rules_met.support: Recovery coverage leverage separates liabilities from skills.
Overlapping claims can exceed deliverable stock.
Pay for independent transferable capacity, not completions alone.

compounds.uncertainty: The training diversion and shared-pool opacity are unverified; pooling can improve efficiency when peaks are complementary.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Apparent certified capacity → restoration coverage issuance
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Underwrite against independently demonstrated substitute capacity instead of scaffolded completion certificates.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: More guaranteed coverage cannot multiply unsupported shared reserve claims through the measured-capacity illusion.

compounds.working_name: Appeal abundance eats apprenticeship

component_ideas.proposition: If agent-generated appeals make case preparation free while independent professional review remains volunteer-funded, successful access expansion can exhaust the expert time needed by complex unassisted cases that produce less machine-readable evidence.

If agents replace novice casework but experts still repair exceptions, concentrating apprenticeship on expert explanations can make the supply of teachable reasoning, rather than task access, the limiting input to future expertise.
If an institution preserves appeals but automates the junior work that trained appeal reviewers, then the rights can remain stable while their exercise becomes slower or more template-dependent.

compounds.strongest_version: Cheap appeal preparation increases substantive review demand while novice learning depends on experts explaining exceptions. If the same experts review and teach, more formally accessible appeals can consume the explanations needed to produce future reviewers.

signed_edges.mechanism: Preparation lowers submission cost.
Experts have a shared time budget.
Novices learn transferable distinctions.
More competent reviewers share work.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Current appeal load suppresses training, leaving fewer future reviewers and increasing load per remaining expert.

compounds.emergent_property: Improved formal appeal access with an endogenous future interpretive-capacity deficit.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Preparation congestion, explanation bottlenecks and reviewer reproduction do not separately close the current-review versus future-training time loop.
compounds.surprising_prediction: At equal case validity, faster appeal preparation can worsen later remedy quality even if current queue staffing is temporarily increased.

measurable_state_variable.name: reviewer reproduction slack
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Expert time available for transferable teaching after necessary review work.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A cohort decline is possible when explanation slack stays below novice-replacement needs through a retirement interval.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Appeal growth does not reduce transferable teaching or subsequent reviewer supply.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same appeal-to-explanation stream can produce richer training material and grow reviewer supply when review generates reusable explanations efficiently.
compounds.neutral_control: Training experts and resources are separate from current appeal throughput.

survival_rules_met.support: Reproduction slack distinguishes present staffing from future supply.
Training slack can fall below replacement needs.
Fund reusable explanation production, not only triage.

compounds.uncertainty: Appeals may reveal genuinely unmet needs; reduced submission is not presumed desirable.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Expert review load → explanation teaching time
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Ring-fence novice instruction time as prepared appeals increase.
